title.narrative: Promoting Human and Environmental Rights in Upper Nile.

description.narrative: Last year 2023 CDoM successfully implemented a pilot integral ecology project in Achiek and Dethwok bomas of Dethwok payam of Fashoda County in Upper Nile State. Within that project, CDoM carried out research on causes of deforestation and degradation of the environment in the county. The research was done in collaboration with the Catholic University of South Sudan. CDoM also formed a Community Human and Environmental Rights Defenders group. A two-module training (each module for a period of one week) was also conducted for those 15 representatives of the local communities to improve their understanding on different environmental issues so that they would be able to carry out awareness in their areas. Another component of the project included the planting of trees to fight the critical phenomenon of deforestation. In order to build on the previous pilot project, CDoM intends to continue implementing this programme for another one year in Fashoda county to continue building the capacity of the youth and engage them to take proactive actions to protect their environment. Therefore, Phase I of the integral ecology project will also build on and complement the running programme in Fashoda county supported by SSCF.
